headline: SpaceX IPO: Elon Musk becomes world's first trillionaire
summary: With SpaceX raising a record $75 billion in its IPO, Musk's net worth is projected to exceed $1.1 trillion as shares begin trading.
details: Elon Musk has become the world's first trillionaire, with his net worth expected to exceed $1.1 trillion. This milestone follows SpaceX's record-breaking initial public offering (IPO) which raised $75 billion on Thursday.
caption:

headline_marked: 30-year jail term for ex-President Yoon over [[drone incursion into North Korea]]
headline: 30-year jail term for ex-President Yoon over drone incursion into North Korea
summary: A South Korean court found the ousted leader guilty of aiding the enemy and abuse of power to create a pretext for martial law.
details: A South Korean court has sentenced former President Yoon Suk Yeol to 30 years in prison on Friday. He was found guilty of ordering a military drone incursion over North Korea in October 2024.
caption:
A former South Korean President gets 30 years in prison.

A South Korean court has sentenced former President Yoon Suk Yeol to 30 years in prison on Friday. He was found guilty of ordering a military drone incursion over North Korea in October 2024.
